models_evaluated: Clinical decision support system for PE diagnosis (Wells rule-based)

links.outcome: Adherence to evidence-based PE diagnostic pathways before vs after human-centred CDSS deployment
links.effect: Overall adherence 0.63 vs 0.60 (p=0.18); D-dimer use 42.9% vs 55.7% (p=0.014) and CTPA use 61.9% vs 75.4% (p=0.005) lower in intervention phase; adherence higher when Wells used.
links.quote: Overall adherence to diagnostic pathways was 0.63 in the CDSS intervention phase versus 0.60 in the preintervention phase (p=0.18), with fewer workups in the CDSS intervention phase having very low adherence scores.

unlisted_practices: Human-centred design of clinical decision support to improve guideline adherence

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world inpatient deployment of a human-centred clinical decision support system incorporating the Wells prediction score for pulmonary embolism diagnosis.

primary.practice: human-centred design of clinical decision support
